instruction.name: xvmaddwev.d.wu.w
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned unsigned 32-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding signed 32-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 64-bit, and add the product to the 64-bit elements in `a`.
